articles.title_en: Ambiguity and technology adoption under index insurance: Experimental evidence
articles.title_cn: 模糊性与指数保险下技术采纳：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effect of ambiguity on technology adoption under index insurance. I conduct an artefactual field experiment with Ghanaian cocoa farmers. Experimental subjects had an option to invest in a package of fertilizer bundled with index insurance. The returns depended both on the subjects’ investment choices and on a stochastic weather realization. The key ingredient of the study was whether the exact probability of bad weather was known or not. This probability was ambiguous in the experimental treatments, and the degree of this ambiguity varied across treatments. A large negative effect on fertilizer investments was found in treatments with either small or large ambiguity. The effect of large ambiguity was also found to be significantly stronger, suggesting that technologies with which farmers are relatively more experienced are more likely to be adopted under index insurance schemes. I provide new evidence that ambiguity may be a significant factor limiting the effectiveness of index insurance in promoting agricultural innovation. The overall findings are complementary to related recent randomized controlled trials, since it is effectively impossible to precisely calibrate and vary the level of ambiguity using the latter methodology.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了模糊性对指数保险下技术采纳的影响。作者在加纳可可农户中进行了一项人为场景实验。实验对象有选择投资一揽子含指数保险的化肥的选项。收益既取决于受试者的投资选择，也取决于随机天气实现。研究的关键在于是否知道恶劣天气的确切概率。该概率在实验处理组中具有模糊性，且模糊程度在不同处理组中存在差异。在模糊性较小或较大的处理组中，化肥投资受到显著的负面影响。研究还发现，模糊性较大的影响更为显著，暗示农户相对更有经验的技术在指数保险方案下更可能被采纳。作者提供了新的证据表明，模糊性可能是限制指数保险在促进农业创新方面有效性的重要因素。总体发现与相关的近期随机对照试验互为补充，因为后者在精确校准和变化模糊水平方面实际上几乎不可能实现。

articles.title_en: Cost and affordability of recommended diets in Rwanda using [near] real-time market data
articles.title_cn: 卢旺达基于[近]实时市场数据的推荐膳食成本与可负担性
articles.abstract_en: Countries are increasingly benchmarking food assistance and labour laws on the cost of nationally recommended diets. Benchmarking is made against national annual estimates, which fail to account for sub-national and intra-annual variation in cost, blunting the impact of policies. Using monthly market price data collected by the Government of Rwanda (April 2019-March 2024), we estimate the cost of the country’s proposed food-based dietary guidelines, using a standardised diet costing methodology. We found rural areas experienced greater inflation in diet cost over the study period than urban areas (41% vs 28%), yet the recommended diet was 12.7% higher in urban locations. Diet costs were approximately 6% lower in districts with international border crossings to Tanzania, but 7% more in those with borders with the Democratic Republic of Congo. Fruits and vegetables (110% and 71%) and starchy staples (86% and 83%) contributed most to cost increases in rural and urban locations respectively. Seasonal diet cost fluctuations were also evident with a seasonal amplitude of 5.6% and 6.9% in rural and urban locations, synchronised to Rwanda’s agricultural calendar. 70% of employed Rwandans would find the recommended diet unaffordable, if spending 52% of wages on food. Diet costs varied 4.2-fold across all districts throughout the study period, meaning that uniform national policies to address costs and affordability would be systematically inadequate in high-cost settings and wasteful in low-cost ones. That such spatial–temporal variation exists in a small, relatively market integrated country like Rwanda suggests variation would be at least equally consequential in other low and lower-middle-income countries. High-frequency and sub-national monitoring of prices, diet costs, and affordability provides essential intelligence for policymakers to enable spatially and seasonally targeted interventions, improving both the adequacy and efficiency of food policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 各国日益将国家推荐膳食的成本作为食品援助和劳动法律的基准。基准通常以国家年度估算为依据，未能考虑子国家和年度内的成本变异，削弱了政策的影响。利用卢旺达政府收集的每月市场价格数据（四月 2019-三月 2024），我们采用标准化的膳食成本核算方法，估算了该国拟议的以食物为基础的膳食指南的成本。研究发现，农村地区在研究期间的膳食成本通胀高于城市地区（41% 对比 28%），但在城市地区推荐膳食的成本更高（12.7%）。在与坦桑尼亚有国际边境的地区，膳食成本大约比其他地区低（6%），而与刚果民主共和国接壤的地区则更高（7%）。水果和蔬菜（110% 和 71%）以及淀粉类主食（86% 和 83%）对农村和城市地区成本的增加贡献最大。季节性膳食成本波动也很明显，农村和城市地区的季节性振幅分别为 5.6% 和 6.9%，与卢旺达的农业季节同步。若卢旺达的在职人员将其工资的 70% 用于食品，则 52% 的人将发现推荐膳食难以负担。研究期间，膳食成本在所有地区的变动范围达 4.2 倍，表明统一的国家政策在高成本地区可能系统性不足，而在低成本地区则可能造成资源浪费。如此空间-时间变异在像卢旺达这样的小型、市场相对一体化的国家中存在，意味着在其他低收入和中低收入国家中，这种变异至少同样具有重要意义。高频率和子国家层面的价格、膳食成本及可负担性监测，为政策制定者提供了关键情报，以实现空间和季节性针对性干预，从而改善食品政策的充足性和效率。

articles.title_en: Seasonality of employment and food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa
articles.title_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区就业季节性与粮食安全
articles.abstract_en: Many rural households in sub-Saharan Africa rely on rainfed agriculture, meaning that harvests and incomes from farming are highly seasonal. This leads to recurring periods of food insecurity, commonly referred to as lean seasons. Off-farm employment may help mitigate seasonal food insecurity, but evidence on whether it actually does remains scarce. Using panel data from high-frequency phone surveys in Burkina Faso, Malawi, and Uganda, covering the period from 2020–2024, we examine seasonal labor reallocation and implications for food security throughout the year. We find that seasonal labor shifts from farming to off-farm sectors are associated with reduced seasonal food insecurity in most contexts, especially for off-farm wage employment. We also find that in regions where multiple cropping seasons are possible, work in farming is more strongly associated with food security than off-farm wage or self-employment. However, seasonal shifts from farming to other income-generating activities are not very large at the aggregate level, possibly due to lack of rural labor opportunities. These findings highlight that — depending on the context — improvements of opportunities for farming and off-farm employment are important to ensure year-round food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa.
articles.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲的许多农村家庭依赖雨养农业，这意味着农作物收获和农业收入具有高度的季节性。这导致粮食安全问题周期性出现，通常被称为粮食短缺季节。非农就业可能有助于缓解季节性粮食不安全问题，但关于其是否确实有效的证据仍然不足。利用布基纳法索、马拉维和乌干达2020-2024年期间的高频电话调查面板数据，我们研究了全年劳动力季节性再分配及其对粮食安全的影响。我们发现，从农业向非农部门的季节性劳动力转移在大多数情况下与季节性粮食不安全的减少相关，尤其是非农工资就业。我们还发现，在可能实现多季种植的地区，农业工作与粮食安全的关联性比非农工资或自雇就业更强。然而，从农业向其他收入生成活动的季节性转移在总体上并不显著，可能是由于农村劳动力机会的缺乏。这些发现表明，根据具体情况，改善农业和非农就业机会对于确保撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区全年的粮食安全至关重要。

articles.title_en: A critical review of EU agri-food policy impacts
articles.title_cn: 对欧盟农业食品政策影响的批判性回顾
articles.abstract_en: The European Union’s agri-food policies aim to balance productivity with environmental, social, and economic sustainability. However, their overall effectiveness remains debated due to fragmented evidence and inconsistent implementation. This study critically reviews the literature on the cumulative impacts of EU policies governing primary agricultural production, focusing on six sectors: the Common Agricultural Policy, genetically modified organisms, pesticide, fertilizers, fisheries, and animal health and welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧洲联盟的农业食品政策旨在平衡生产力与环境、社会和经济的可持续性。然而，由于证据碎片化和执行不一致，其整体有效性仍存在争议。本研究对关于欧盟管理初级农业生产的政策累积影响的文献进行了批判性回顾，重点关注农业、转基因生物、农药、化肥、渔业以及动物健康与福利等六个领域。

articles.title_en: Agenda-setting in local food environment policy: A comparative Multiple Streams Analysis of the City Deal network in the Netherlands
articles.title_cn: 地方食品环境政策中的议程设置：荷兰城市合作网络的多重流分析比较
articles.abstract_en: Little is known about the processes through which local food environment policies gain a place on municipal policy agendas. This study examines why some municipalities within the Dutch City Deal: Healthy and Sustainable Food Environment succeed in placing food strategies and food environmental zoning policies on the agenda.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于地方食品环境政策如何进入市政政策议程的过程知之甚少。本研究探讨为何荷兰城市合作：健康与可持续食品环境中的某些市政当局能够成功将食品策略和食品环境分区政策列入议程。

articles.title_en: Extreme heat and markets: Theoretical and empirical evidence from Nigeria
articles.title_cn: 极端高温与市场：尼日利亚的理论与实证证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how exposure to extreme temperature affects smallholder commercialization. We examine a range of outcomes that indicate the degree of commercialization, including market participation, sales quantity, commercialization index, and sales revenue, which serves as an indicator of monetary benefit. Recognizing the non-separability between production and commercialization, we also examine how extreme temperature directly affects agricultural production. To address these questions, we develop a simple and straightforward theoretical framework that links temperature events to production and market dynamics. From this framework, we derive a set of hypotheses which we proceed to test empirically. Our empirical strategy leverages a comprehensive three-wave panel dataset, which we integrate with earth observation data on temperature extremes. We find that extreme temperatures lead to production losses. We also observe significant declines in market participation among smallholder farmers which could be explained by production shortfalls. This reduction is evident at both the extensive margin (likelihood of participating in markets) and the intensive margin (sales quantity). Furthermore, we observe that when farmers face extreme temperatures, the proportion of harvested crops they sell and the resulting revenue from these also decrease. Causal mediation analysis further confirms that production losses due to extreme temperatures explains the reduction in market outcomes. Overall, these findings highlight the broader economic burden that extreme weather events continue to impose on smallholder households.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究极端温度暴露如何影响小农户的商品化程度。我们考察一系列反映商品化程度的结果指标，包括市场参与、销售数量、商品化指数和销售收入，后者作为货币收益的指标。鉴于生产与商品化之间的非可分离性，我们还分析极端温度如何直接影响农业生产。为此，我们建立了一个简洁直观的理论框架，将温度事件与生产和市场动态联系起来。基于此框架，我们提出一系列假设，并进行实证检验。我们的实证策略利用一份全面的三-波段面板数据集，并结合关于温度极端事件的遥感数据。研究发现，极端温度导致生产损失。我们还观察到小农户的市场参与显著下降，这可能由生产短缺引起。这一减少在市场参与的广度（参与市场的可能性）和深度（销售数量）两个方面均有体现。此外，当农户面临极端温度时，他们出售的收获作物比例及由此产生的收入也会减少。因果中介分析进一步确认，极端温度引起的生产损失解释了市场结果的下降。总体而言，这些发现凸显了极端天气事件对小农户家庭持续带来的更广泛的经济负担。

articles.title_en: Consumer preferences for sustainability labels: A comparative analysis of the green-score and other established labels
articles.title_cn: 消费者对可持续性标签的偏好：绿色评分与其他既有标签的比较分析
articles.abstract_en: The Green-Score label aims to complement established certifications by providing a standardized and easily interpretable assessment of products’ environmental performance. This study examines (i) the relative influence of Green-Score, organic, and Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) certifications on consumers’ willingness to pay (WTP); (ii) how label effectiveness varies across food categories; and (iii) the impact of a salience nudge on consumer choices. A Discrete Choice Experiment was conducted with a nationally representative sample of 1,102 Italian consumers, using a between-subjects design to evaluate the nudge. Results show that PDO labels, leveraging strong institutional credibility and symbolic value, consistently generate the highest marginal WTP (€7.61), especially for culturally and traditionally significant products. Green-Score A+ labels, valued for their diagnosticity and cross-product comparability, achieve an average marginal WTP of €6.25, slightly above organic certification (€4.59), with variation across product categories and treatment conditions. The salience nudge enhances the perceived value of Green-Score, particularly in contexts where environmental performance is salient, and can reduce the marginal contribution of overlapping labels such as organic certification. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of sustainability labels depends on both the balance between credibility and diagnosticity and the product-specific context, offering actionable insights for policymakers and stakeholders seeking to design targeted and effective environmental labelling strategies in food markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色评分标签旨在通过提供产品环境绩效的标准化和易于理解的评估来补充既有认证。本研究考察了（i）绿色评分、有机和原产地保护（PDO）认证对消费者支付意愿（WTP）的相对影响；（ii）标签效果如何因食品类别而异；（iii）显著性提示对消费者选择的影响。研究采用离散选择实验，以1,102名具有全国代表性的意大利消费者为样本，使用被试间设计评估提示效果。结果表明，PDO标签凭借其强大的机构信誉和象征价值，始终产生最高的边际支付意愿（7.61欧元），尤其是对文化和传统意义重大的产品。绿色评分A+标签因其诊断性和跨产品可比性，实现了6.25欧元的平均边际支付意愿，略高于有机认证（4.59欧元），且因产品类别和处理条件而异。显著性提示增强了绿色评分的感知价值，特别是在环境绩效显著的情境中，并可降低有机认证等重叠标签的边际贡献。这些发现表明，可持续性标签的有效性取决于信誉与诊断性之间的平衡以及产品特定情境，为政策制定者和利益相关者提供了可操作的洞察，以设计针对性和有效的食品市场环境标签策略。

articles.title_en: UK Food standards agency proposals for re-structuring how it regulates food-borne risks: an analysis and critique
articles.title_cn: 英国食品标准局关于重组其食品安全风险监管方式的提案：分析与批评
articles.abstract_en: Official food policy-makers are expected both to ensure that they have a well-functioning system of food supply, processing, distribution and consumption while also ensuring that their citizens are protected from unsafe and unhealthy foods. It is evident that the implications of those two responsibilities can and sometimes do conflict; which historically has prompted the question: should those two policy responsibilities be institutionally co-located, or institutionally separated? The UK’s Food Standards Agency (FSA) was created in response to the policy failures revealed by the Mad Cow Disease saga. Previously one UK ministry had been responsible for both agendas, but the tension between them had been so severe that they contributed to turning the saga into a deep crisis. Responsibility for ensuring UK food safety was subsequently separated from the food industries’ sponsoring ministry, and transferred to the FSA. A recent set of proposals from the FSA recommends that the agency should expand its responsibilities by also endeavouring to promote the commercial interests of the food industries. Implementing the proposals risks undermining public confidence in the FSA and the safety of the UK’s food supply. The significance of the proposals goes beyond the UK as it illustrates a pivotal and ubiquitous axis of contestation in food policy-making, it illustrates ways in which food policy governance can be malleable rather than rigid, and explains how a combination of forgetfulness and economic re-prioritisation risks undermining food safety and public trust in policy-making.
articles.abstract_cn: 官方食品政策制定者既要确保食品供应、加工、分销和消费体系的正常运作，又要保障公民免受不安全和不健康食品的危害。显而易见，这些责任的影响可能会发生冲突；这在历史上引发了一个问题：这些政策责任应当在制度上合并还是分离？英国食品标准局（FSA）成立的背景是应对疯牛病事件暴露的政策失误。此前，英国的相关部门同时负责这两个方面，但二者之间的紧张关系极为严重，导致事件演变成一场深刻的危机。确保英国食品安全的责任随后从食品行业的主管部门中剥离出来，转交给FSA。FSA近期提出的一系列建议建议该机构应扩大职责，兼顾促进食品行业的商业利益。实施这些建议可能会削弱公众对FSA及英国食品安全的信心。这些提案的意义超越英国，展示了食品政策制定中的一个关键且普遍存在的争论轴心，揭示了食品政策治理可以具有弹性而非刚性，以及说明了遗忘与经济再优先排序的结合如何可能削弱食品安全和公众对政策的信任。

articles.title_en: The impact of post-harvest training interventions on adoption and production behavior: evidence from black pepper farmers in Sri Lanka
articles.title_cn: 收获后培训干预对采纳和生产行为的影响：来自斯里兰卡黑胡椒农户的证据
articles.abstract_en: As agricultural development increasingly targets high-value crops and markets, food quality and safety have become critical. However, smallholder farmers often face barriers to adopting quality-enhancing practices in the post-production stage because of their limited access to reliable information. Most research on information provision emphasises the need to reduce quantity losses in staple crops, leaving a research gap with respect to quality improvements in high-value crops such as black pepper. This study addresses this gap by evaluating the impact of government training and farmer-to-farmer experience sharing on the adoption of post-harvest quality improvement practices and production behaviour. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 660 black pepper farmers in the Matale District of Sri Lanka. We found that government training significantly improves the adoption of key post-harvest practices such as threshing, fresh berry grading, dry berry grading, and blanching and leads to a shift in production from low quality to high quality. Our findings highlight the importance of structured expertise-led training to improve the quality of high-value crops.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着农业发展日益聚焦于高价值作物和市场，食品质量与安全变得至关重要。然而，小农户在采后阶段采用提升质量的实践中常面临信息获取有限的障碍。大部分关于信息提供的研究强调减少主粮作物的产量损失，忽视了高价值作物如黑胡椒的质量改善研究空白。本研究通过评估政府培训和农户间经验分享对采后质量改善实践采纳和生产行为的影响，填补了这一空白。我们在斯里兰卡马塔勒区对660黑胡椒农户进行了随机对照试验。研究发现，政府培训显著促进了打谷、鲜果等级划分、干果等级划分以及漂白等关键采后实践的采纳，并促使生产从低质量向高质量转变。我们的研究结果强调了结构化、由专业人员主导的培训在提升高价值作物质量方面的重要作用。

articles.title_en: Regulatory heterogeneity, trade mediation and nutrient intake: The case of Trans fat
articles.title_cn: 监管异质性、贸易中介作用与营养摄入：反式脂肪的案例
articles.abstract_en: National nutrition regulations can shape diets in two distinct ways: directly, through domestic policy mechanisms, and indirectly, by mediating trade flows. This study assesses how trans fat (TF) intake is affected by both pathways. When countries act alone – by banning or limiting TF – their rules often differ in timing, stringency, and enforcement. The resulting regulatory heterogeneity can create loopholes that allow unhealthy products to move across borders. This study estimates the causal effects of TF regulations on its intake nationally by constructing a food-item-level panel dataset for 161 countries (2010–2022, validated with established benchmarks), and applying a staggered difference-in-differences approach combined with mediation analysis. The findings show that strict, enforceable regulations, such as those in the United States and European Union, significantly reduce TF intake and imports, acting as effective filters against TF-rich foods. In contrast, countries with weaker regulations experience rising TF imports and, eventually, increased intake, effectively placing them at risk of becoming “dietary risk havens.” Even modest rules work better when backed by strong monitoring. These results are robust to alternative specifications such as controlling for importer-specific foreign regulatory exposure. The causal evidence demonstrates that unilateral action delivers meaningful health gains, but fragmented regulatory approaches create opportunities for “regulatory dumping.” This study underscores the need for global cooperation – through harmonized standards or trade-linked enforcement – to prevent cross-border displacement of dietary risks. Beyond TF, the findings offer timely insights for emerging national and global mandates on other nutrients, such as salt, sugar, and saturated fats.
articles.abstract_cn: 国家营养法规可以通过两种不同方式影响饮食：直接通过国内政策机制，以及间接通过调节贸易流动。本研究评估反式脂肪（TF）摄入受到这两条路径的影响。当各国单独采取行动——通过禁止或限制TF——其法规在时间、严格程度和执行力度上常常存在差异。这种监管异质性可能导致漏洞，使不健康产品得以跨境流动。本研究通过构建161国家（2010-2022，采用已建立的基准验证）食品项目层面的面板数据集，并结合分段差异中的差异法与中介分析，估算TF法规对其国内摄入的因果效应。结果显示，像美国和欧盟那样的严格、可执行的法规显著降低了TF的摄入和进口，起到了有效过滤富含TF食品的作用。相反，法规较弱的国家进口和摄入量逐步上升，最终增加摄入，实际上使其面临成为“饮食风险避风港”的风险。即使是温和的法规，在强有力的监测支持下也能取得更好的效果。这些结果对控制进口国特定的外国监管暴露等替代规格的稳健性检验均保持一致。因果证据表明，单边行动能带来显著的健康改善，但碎片化的监管方式也为“监管倾销”提供了机会。本文强调需要通过协调标准或与贸易挂钩的执法实现全球合作，以防止跨境饮食风险的转移。除了反式脂肪外，这些发现为新兴国家和全球范围内关于盐、糖和饱和脂肪等其他营养素的法规制定提供了及时的见解。

articles.title_en: Fostering legume purchases with behavioural interventions: evidence from field experiments in online and offline supermarkets
articles.title_cn: 通过行为干预促进豆类购买：来自线上与线下超市的实地实验证据
articles.abstract_en: The protein transition is a crucial element of the transition to sustainable food systems, and both EU and national policies aim to foster the consumption of plant-based proteins. Supermarkets as the primary source of food products in many countries represent a promising environment for translating these policy objectives into practice. With three studies from Denmark, including a representative online survey (n = 838 participants) followed by randomised controlled trials in a real online supermarket in two rounds over 6 weeks (n = 9,093 transactions Round 1; n = 8,706 transactions Round 2) and field experiments in physical brick-and-mortar stores (9 test stores, 13 control stores, 21 days of observation), this research investigates the potential of leveraging behavioural interventions to foster legume purchases in online and offline retail settings. The randomised controlled trials in the online supermarket showed that placement interventions in the vegetable section were effective in increasing sales of legumes by 57%, while placement interventions in the meat section were not effective, suggesting that the strategies known to work for highly processed plant-based meat substitutes cannot be translated to legumes. The field experiments in brick-and-mortar supermarkets confirmed that the vegetable section is a promising intervention point. The multi-layered intervention tested (bundling placement combined with a recipe inspiration poster) significantly increased legume purchases to a similar degree as in the other study.
articles.abstract_cn: 蛋白质转型是实现可持续食品体系转型的关键要素，欧盟及各国政策均致力于促进植物蛋白的消费。超市作为许多国家食品产品的主要来源，是将这些政策目标转化为实践的有前景的环境。本文基于丹麦的三项研究，包括一项具有代表性的线上问卷调查（n = 838名参与者），随后在真实线上超市中分两轮、为期6周的随机对照试验（第9,093轮n = 1笔交易；第8,706轮n = 2笔交易），以及在线下实体门店的实地实验（9家实验门店，13家对照门店，21天观察），探讨了在线上与线下零售环境中利用行为干预促进豆类购买的潜力。线上超市的随机对照试验显示，在蔬菜区进行陈列干预能有效提升豆类销量57%，而在肉类区的陈列干预则无效，表明已知对高度加工的植物基肉类替代品有效的策略并不能直接应用于豆类。线下实体超市的实地实验进一步证实，蔬菜区是有前景的干预点。多层次干预（陈列捆绑结合菜谱启发海报）显著提升了豆类购买，提升幅度与其他研究相当。

articles.title_en: Viewpoint: evaluating transparency and market consequences of the national bioengineered food disclosure standard in the United States
articles.title_cn: 观点：评估美国国家生物工程食品披露标准的透明度及市场后果
articles.abstract_en: The 2018 National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS) mandated disclosure of bioengineered (BE) ingredients in regulated foods in the United States, with full compliance required by January 2022. The policy is intended to reduce information asymmetry by enabling consumers to infer BE status through mandatory labeling, alongside existing voluntary claims such as organic and non-GMO labels. This viewpoint paper concludes that the current design and implementation of the NBFDS do not fully support this transparency objective in practice. We show that several regulatory features weaken the inference mechanism linking disclosure to consumer understanding on which the policy relies, including evolving definition and terminology associated with BE foods, electronic and digital disclosure options, detectability-based exclusions for highly refined products, exemptions from mandatory disclosure, and limited ingredient specificity. As a result, under the current design, mandatory BE labeling increases consumer search costs and cognitive burden while creating implementation challenges for industry. These findings underscore the importance of careful policy design in achieving effective transparency. Continued evaluation and evidence-based refinement are needed to improve the effectiveness of the law.
articles.abstract_cn: 2018年的国家生物工程食品披露标准（NBFDS）要求在美国对受管制食品中披露生物工程（BE）成分，全面合规截止日期为2022年一月。该政策旨在通过强制性标签披露，使消费者能够推断BE状态，从而减少信息不对称，同时还有现有的自愿声明，如有机和非转基因标签。本观点论文得出结论，NBFDS的当前设计和实施在实践中并未完全支持这一透明度目标。我们表明，几项监管特征削弱了披露与消费者理解之间的推断机制，这是政策依赖的，包括与BE食品相关的不断演变的定义和术语、电子和数字披露选项、对高度精制产品的检测性排除、强制披露豁免以及有限的成分特定性。因此，在当前设计下，强制性BE标签增加了消费者的搜索成本和认知负担，同时为行业带来了实施挑战。这些发现强调了在实现有效透明度时仔细政策设计的重要性。需要持续评估和基于证据的改进，以提高法律的有效性。

articles.title_en: Digital literacy training to promote diffusion of digital agricultural tools to smallholder farmers: evidence from a randomized intervention in Egypt
articles.title_cn: 数字素养培训促进数字农业工具在小农户中的推广：埃及随机干预的证据
articles.abstract_en: Despite growing enthusiasm about the potential of digital innovations to transform agrifood systems, adoption among smallholder farmers in Africa remains low and heterogeneous. While the proliferation of digital tools targeting smallholder farmers is encouraging, the vast majority remain at pilot stages, facing barriers such as limited awareness among farmer, digital illiteracy, usability challenges, and low trust among farmers. This paper evaluates alternative digital literacy interventions designed to address these demand-side barriers and enhance smallholder farmers’ knowledge, utilization, trust, and uptake of two Egyptian mobile apps offering marketing, advisory, and input delivery services. Following a Training of Trainers (TOT) model, we designed and implemented a randomized controlled trial to test three variants of digital literacy training: standard classroom-based digital literacy training (T1), digital training complemented (preceded) by a video-based play (T2), digital training complemented (preceded) by a live community play (T3), and a control group (C). We find that the different variants of digital training led to statistically significant increases in uptake and utilization of digital tools. Specifically, the standard digital training alone increased uptake by 20 percentage points and utilization by 18 percentage points. The interventions also improved farmers’ trust in digital tools by 8–13 percentage points. Surprisingly, for some outcomes, the digital literacy training alone outperformed the combined approaches that incorporated edutainment nudges. We explore possible explanations, including group size effects and social influence dynamics during the plays. We also document heterogeneity in the impact of these interventions across farmers’ gender and age. Our findings offer insights into designing cost-effective, scalable interventions that build digital capabilities and trust among smallholder farmers, while cautioning against assuming edutainment always strengthens adoption outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管对数字创新有望变革农产品系统的潜力日益热衷，但非洲小农户的采用率仍然较低且存在异质性。虽然针对小农户的数字工具的普及令人鼓舞，但绝大多数仍处于试点阶段，面临诸如农户认知有限、数字素养不足、可用性挑战以及农户信任度低等障碍。本文评估旨在解决这些需求侧障碍、提升小农户对提供市场营销、咨询和投入配送服务的埃及二移动应用的认知、利用、信任和采纳的数字素养干预措施。采用培训师培训（TOT）模式，我们设计并实施了一项随机对照试验，测试三数字素养培训的不同变体：标准的课堂数字素养培训（T1）、在数字培训前辅以视频播放（T2）、在数字培训前辅以现场社区剧（T3），以及对照组（C）。研究发现，不同的数字培训变体在提升数字工具的采纳和利用方面具有统计学显著性。具体而言，单独的标准数字培训使采纳率提高了20个百分点，利用率提高了18个百分点。这些干预措施还使农户对数字工具的信任度提高了8-13个百分点。令人惊讶的是，在某些结果中，单一的数字素养培训优于结合娱乐教育元素的多种干预方式。我们探讨了可能的解释，包括小组规模效应和剧中社会影响动力学。我们还记录了这些干预措施在不同性别和年龄农户中的异质性影响。我们的研究结果为设计具有成本效益、可扩展的干预措施提供了见解，旨在提升小农户的数字能力和信任，同时提醒不要假设娱乐教育元素总能增强采纳效果。

articles.title_en: Does school lunch equalize? An examination of dietary quality and socioeconomic disparities in Germany
articles.title_cn: 学校午餐能否实现平衡？德国饮食质量与社会经济差异的检验
articles.abstract_en: An adequate diet is essential for children’s cognitive, physical, and educational development, yet children from lower socioeconomic backgrounds are more likely to have poorer dietary quality, reinforcing social inequalities. This study examines whether the offer of school lunch can mitigate the effect of socioeconomic status on children’s total daily dietary quality. Using food frequency data from the second wave of the German KiGGS study (2014–2017), we construct an updated Healthy Nutrition Score for Kids and Youth (HuSKY) to capture overall dietary quality in a single measure. We focus on children between 6 and 13 years and proxy school lunch using attendance at after-school care facilities that typically offer school lunch. To address potential selection bias between children with and without such a lunch offer, we apply propensity score matching. We then estimate a mixed-effects model on the matched sample (n = 2,212) to analyze the effects of socioeconomic status, school lunch offer, and their interaction on total daily dietary quality. Our results corroborate that dietary quality is higher among children with higher socioeconomic status and is also positively associated with receiving a school lunch offer. Beyond supporting prior findings, we find that the positive association between socioeconomic status and dietary quality is substantially weaker among children receiving a school lunch offer. Accordingly, we conclude that school lunch may help reduce socioeconomic disparities in dietary quality. Future research should examine whether these improvements help reduce broader inequalities in health, education, and income. Policymakers should consider these potential benefits in the ongoing debate surrounding (free) school lunch provision.
articles.abstract_cn: 充足的饮食对儿童的认知、身体和教育发展至关重要，然而来自较低社会经济背景的儿童更可能拥有较差的饮食质量，从而加剧社会不平等。本研究考察学校午餐的提供是否能够减轻社会经济地位对儿童每日总饮食质量的影响。利用德国KiGGS研究（第二）中2014-2017波段的食物频率数据，我们构建了更新的儿童与青少年健康营养评分（HuSKY），以单一指标反映整体饮食质量。研究对象为6至13年龄段的儿童，利用通常提供学校午餐的课后照料机构的出席情况作为学校午餐的代理变量。为应对有无学校午餐提供的儿童之间可能存在的选择偏差，我们采用倾向得分匹配方法。在匹配样本（样本量为2,212）上，应用混合效应模型估算社会经济地位、学校午餐提供及其交互作用对每日总饮食质量的影响。结果显示，社会经济地位较高的儿童饮食质量较好，且接受学校午餐的儿童饮食质量也呈正相关。除支持先前的研究发现外，我们还发现，社会经济地位与饮食质量之间的正向关系在接受学校午餐的儿童中显著减弱。因此，我们得出结论，学校午餐可能有助于减少饮食质量方面的社会经济差异。未来的研究应探讨这些改善是否有助于缩小健康、教育和收入等更广泛的不平等。政策制定者应在关于（免费）学校午餐提供的持续辩论中考虑这些潜在的益处。

articles.title_en: Defaults harmonize our food choices – a systematic data review of default effects across socio-demographic groups
articles.title_cn: 默认设置协调我们的食品选择——一项关于不同社会人口群体默认效应的系统数据综述
articles.abstract_en: Food policy often struggles to reach diverse population groups, and well-intentioned interventions can sometimes exacerbate inequalities along socio-demographic groups. This systematic data review examines whether default nudges in food choices have consistent effects across different socio-demographic groups, or whether their impact varies depending on factors such as education level, age, and gender. After selecting eligible studies, authors from 12 studies shared their primary data and were subsequently included in the Default Nudge Research & Data Sharing Consortium (Table A2). These primary data enabled us to analyze 40 interaction effects examining whether age, gender, and education moderate the effectiveness of defaults relative to active choice conditions. Results show no consistent and rarely any interaction effects, suggesting defaults influence food decisions similarly across socio-demographic groups. A possible exception is that harmful defaults may be more effective among less educated individuals. These findings highlight default nudges as a broadly equitable behavioral tool in food policy design.
articles.abstract_cn: 食品政策常常难以覆盖多样化的人口群体，善意的干预措施有时可能加剧沿社会人口群体的差异。本系统数据综述考察了食品选择中的默认引导是否在不同社会人口群体中具有一致的效果，或其影响是否因教育水平、年龄和性别等因素而异。在筛选符合条件的研究后，来自12研究的作者共享了他们的原始数据，并随后被纳入默认引导研究与数据共享联盟（表A2）。这些原始数据使我们能够分析40交互作用，检验年龄、性别和教育是否调节默认设置相对于主动选择条件的有效性。结果显示没有一致且几乎没有交互作用，表明默认设置在不同社会人口群体中对食品决策的影响类似。一个可能的例外是，有害的默认设置在教育程度较低的个体中可能更为有效。这些发现强调了默认引导作为一种广泛公平的行为工具在食品政策设计中的作用。

articles.title_en: Impact of gardening and nutrition support provided to women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 为孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔难民营妇女提供园艺和营养支持的影响
articles.abstract_en: Nearly one million Rohingya refugees, displaced by the Myanmar civil war, live in densely populated camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh. While food aid addresses some of their immediate needs, additional solutions are necessary to foster self-reliance, as many have been living in camps for years with little hope of returning home. Gardening is one approach that could enhance diets, food security, and incomes, but evidence for the impact of home garden programs in refugee camps remains limited. The objective of this study is to evaluate the impact of a home garden and nutrition program on the diets and food security of pregnant and lactating women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar. A cluster-randomized controlled trial was conducted, with pre- and post-intervention data collected from 1050 women, evenly split into control and treatment groups. A difference-in-differences estimator was used to measure the intent-to-treat effects. Lack of space was the primary obstacle to gardening, but sack gardens and rooftop gardens offered solutions. Women reported many benefits from gardening beyond food consumption, such as personal joy and making the house look nice. The intervention led to a 17-percentage point increase in garden adoption (p = 0.018) and a 57-percentage point rise in households sourcing fruits and vegetables from their gardens (p < 0.001). It also improved nutrition knowledge by 23 percentage points (p < 0.001) and household food security by 66% (p < 0.05). The intervention led to a significant increase of 1 additional serving of fruit per week, but there was no significant increase in vegetable intake. These findings clearly show the benefits of providing gardening and nutrition training to nutritionally vulnerable women in densely populated refugee camps.
articles.abstract_cn: 近一百万因缅甸内战流离失所的罗兴亚难民居住在孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔人口密集的难民营中。虽然粮食援助解决了部分他们的即时需求，但由于许多人已在营地生活多年且几乎没有回家的希望，仍需额外方案以促进自力更生。园艺是一种能够改善饮食、粮食安全和收入的方法，但关于家庭园艺项目在难民营影响的证据仍有限。本研究旨在评估家庭园艺和营养项目对科克斯巴扎尔难民营孕妇和哺乳期妇女饮食和粮食安全的影响。采用集群随机对照试验，干预前后共收集了1050名妇女的数据，控制组和干预组人数均等。使用双重差分估计量测量意向性处理效应。空间不足是园艺的主要障碍，但袋式花园和屋顶花园提供了解决方案。妇女们报告园艺带来的诸多益处，除了食物消费外，还包括个人愉悦和美化家园。干预使园艺采纳率提高了17个百分点（p = 0.018），家庭从自家园艺获取水果和蔬菜的比例上升了57个百分点（p < 0.001）。此外，营养知识提升了23个百分点（p < 0.001），家庭粮食安全提高了66%（p < 0.05）。干预显著增加了每周水果摄入量1份，但蔬菜摄入量无显著增加。这些结果清楚显示，在人口密集的难民营为营养脆弱妇女提供园艺和营养培训具有明显益处。
